title: The reach repair is accepted
situation: The reach check failed deterministically on dev and blocked every push. The lead found the cause in the check's setup, not the product: omp 18.10.2 stopped offering the yield tool to dispatched agents unless a setting turns it on, and the check's model stand-in recognised the dispatched agent by that tool. The unchanged check passes under omp 18.8.9 to 18.10.1 at every dev commit since the delivery merge; the operator's earlier sighting of a failure before the upgrade was not reproduced.
decision: Accepted without assayers, as a one-test repair (proportionality): the stand-in now recognises the dispatched agent by the model its declaration names; every assertion is unchanged and was seen to fail against a declaration shown only reading verbs and one that cannot reach the journal; the whole deterministic suite is green.
consequences: The check no longer depends on how omp returns a dispatched agent's result. On failure it should print which tools each dispatched agent was offered (the lead's hardening note).
